summary: Unpinned GitHub dependency resolves to mutable HEAD at install
details: package.json declares `libsignal` as `github:wanzchil/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or semver pin. On `npm install`, this dependency source is resolved to the current HEAD of that GitHub repository, fetched, and installed — including execution of any lifecycle scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) present in that repo's tree at the moment of resolution. There is no integrity check and no version pinning, so the code executed on the installer's machine at install time is whatever the owner of `wanzchil/libsignal-node` has pushed to the default branch at that instant, and can change from install to install without any change to this package. This is an off-registry dependency source: the manifest itself is the installation vector, independent of the current contents of the referenced repository.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
